prompt: On 1 January 2024 (order_date 2024-01-01), which orders had 3 or more order lines? Use the sales table, which has one row per order line. Return order_id and n_lines, the number of lines of the order, one row per order. Any row order is fine. Which query returns it?

options.text:
SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM sales
WHERE order_date = DATE '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 3

SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM sales
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM sales
WHERE order_date = DATE '2024-01-01'
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS n_lines
FROM sales
WHERE order_date = DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND units >= 3
GROUP BY order_id
